newsitem.title: UK: CU, B.A.T gain on renewed merger talk.
newsitem.headline: CU, B.A.T gain on renewed merger talk.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc and B.A.T Industries Plc were among the biggeste gainers in a sharply higher UK stock market on Tuesday, amid renewed bid talk in the insurance sector, dealers said.
Dealers said there was fresh talk of a bid from B.A.T Industries Plc or a merger between the conglomerate's insurance operations and CU.
Shares in CU were up 19p or 2.7 percent by 1620 GMT, outpacing the 1.4 percent rise in the FTSE 100 index, while B.A.T shares were up 19-1/2p or 4.1 percent at 492.
"We have seen a resumption of bid talk around CU and B.A.T and that has lifted the whole insurance sector," said one dealer.
Elswhere among composite insurance stocks, General Accident Plc was up 11-1/2p at 788 and Royal Sun Alliance Plc was up 10-1/2p at 453-1/2.
